iterations.changes: First independently authored semantic scene, from empty Blender file. 71 named assemblies; structures, windows, furniture, decorative mirrors, plants and wicker lamps.
observations: Overall L-shaped hall and main wall/column/furniture arrangement correspond to allowed RGB.
Lighting overly bright; furniture too pale.
Wall grain runs horizontally due to primitive UV layout.
Near lounge table/seats too close to first camera.
Several distant pendants have cross-view disagreements due to input depth scale variation.

changes: Aligned vertical wall grain by explicit UV coordinates.
Reduced fill lighting and upholstery brightness.
Located near table and seating from calibrated RGB rays using seat/table heights supported by triangulated farther furniture.
Reduced planter width/height and increased ornamental-grass leaf density.
Moved three rear pendants using manually inspected RGB two-view matches with less than 1.4 px reprojection error at 780 px width. Added three pendants measured in reverse view.
Thickened door frame to match observed brass border.
remaining_concerns: Pendant placement and exact height remain weak under inconsistent predicted depths.
Fine decorative weave, leaf arrangement, joints and hidden backsides are inferred.
Bright glazing is an appearance proxy; glass depth is unreliable.
Near-chair backrest ends show dark shading artifacts in views60/138; independent review should prioritize whether geometry or shading needs correction.
Glossy inset reflections remain more blurred and lower contrast than RGB.
Bright door and window surrounds are approximate; glass is represented by a luminous sheet.

iterations.changes: Clean-review repairs: added ottoman, normals/manifold fix, near-furniture refit, tropical planter placement, door position and width, accepted pendant matches, collision finish and metadata relations.
iterations.observations: Major chair black wedges disappeared and missing objects became visible; near tabletop orientation remained wrong and a reverse-view pendant was identified as a duplicate.

changes: M4-R01: Added lounge_seat_8, the fourth near-group piece, as a separately named round ottoman. Frame60 top-circle and adjacent66 right-edge evidence retained.

M4-R02: Reversed final backrest end-cap winding; recalculated closed-mesh face normals; reduced bevel radius. All four backrest meshes have zero nonmanifold edges and positive signed volume. Own frames60/138 visually checked.

M4-R03: Near ottoman silhouette rays from frames0/60/138 yield radius0.352m, radial RMS0.030m. Other near pieces refit from calibrated frame60 rays, with adjacent66 check. Near seat top lowered0.52→0.42m. The final tabletop uses an inspected frame60 color-continuity boundary (729 boundary samples), inverse projection to z0.4, and a fitted ellipse with radii0.4641/0.4275m and angle-0.4062rad. Middle-chair facing corrected to match its visible back.
M4-R04: Moved tropical_front_0 to native (11.10,20.16) from frame60 visible planter top/base rays, restoring its right-edge presence; reverse-view semantic correspondence retained.

M4-R05: Five explicitly matched pendants accepted below2.5px reprojection error at780px width, and their centers/radii updated. Three ambiguous matches rejected and kept in the diagnostic. No new fixture was added in revision3. Revision4 removes pendant_front_00: accepted pendant13 from frames0/60 projects within3.8px of the same reverse90 fixture, establishing that the single-view addition was a duplicate.
M4-R06: Door0 edges from frame100 imply center x13.021m and width2.073m; door1 edges from108 imply x22.848m and width1.955m. Frames widened, rail/stile silhouette corrected.
M4-R07: Added a static role=floor collider for floor_dark_inset, with contact_surface_z matching visible topz0.041. Consumers should use the highest supporting floor surface.

M4-R08: Added furniture/plant/table supported_by, mirror mounted_on and pendant suspended_from relations. Numeric uncertainties now explicitly state heuristic author estimates, not calibrated confidence. Measured objects link specific measurement JSON records.
M4-R09: Reduced floor roughness and sharpened/brightened small mosaic pattern; table made darker and less reflective; central lamp diffusers reduced in brightness.
remaining_concerns: Manual outlines and assumed horizontal heights are imperfect. The final tabletop boundary fit has normalized radial RMS0.038; neither uncertainty nor fidelity is statistically calibrated.
Other fixture identities, suspension height and cross-view diameter remain approximate; repeated weave makes correspondences ambiguous and predicted depth windows disagree.
Glass is still a bright appearance proxy; concealed opening mechanisms are inferred.
BRDFs and lighting are inferred; the original concentrated reflection pattern and fabric appearance are not fully reproduced.
iterations.validation: Backrests manifold and positive signed volume; required JSON/GLB/camera interfaces valid; input frame and metric axes unchanged.

failed_tool_attempts: Sandbox bwrap loopback setup failed; permitted escalation used.
Initial cv2 triangulation script could not import cv2; replaced with installed scikit-image SIFT and NumPy SVD. No image or geometry changed.
One shell Python diagnostic had a ternary whitespace syntax error, corrected before applying revision.
Revision3 pendant diagnostic initially could not serialize numpy.bool_ to JSON; cast to builtin bool and reran from the preserved v2 parameter snapshot.
